sources.name: U.S. Supreme Court (supremecourt.gov)
sources.coverage: Slip + preliminary-print + bound-volume PDFs. Horn already has official 604 U.S. 593 in the OT 2024 prelim (604us2r23).

sources.survey_verdict: WIRE IN tier 1 for current-Term official pages

wiring_recommendation.note: The four already-wired sources cover published pins inside CAP's window. Survey 2026-09-19: existence is CL citation-lookup (token) or fielded citation:"…" plus caption — never bare q=. Pin confirmation is CAP page-labels or official U.S. Reports PDFs. New probes add value where CAP/CL miss: recent CA9/CA4 PDFs, district USCOURTS packages, and current-Term SCOTUS prelims.
priority_order: courtlistener fielded citation: / citation-lookup (primary existence; do not use bare q=)
cap_static metadata + HTML page-label (corroborator + only free star pin, inside the cliff)
supremecourt_gov prelim/slip list (official 604 U.S. 593 already posted; CAP will never have it)
ca9_cdn (filename confirmed; opt-in probe now fetches opinions + memoranda; require court+date)
govinfo USREPORTS-{vol}-{page}.pdf then POST + name-match (official API, ranking is not a citator)
courts_ca_gov + scocal (Cal. direct PDFs; add cal-2d to REPORTER_MAP rather than treating CAP as missing it)
do_not_wire: justia / findlaw / openjurist / scholar from a datacenter (Cloudflare or bot 403)
